'''2001 Denver DPC Episode I booster draft''' was a Star Wars CCG booster draft held in Tacticon, Denver, Colorado on 1 September 2001. [[Chris Fanchi]] won it. It is known from Chris Fanchi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2937">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-05-episode-i-sealed-deck-tacticon-denverd2937/ episode-i-sealed-deck-tacticon-denver], DeckTech (Chris "Artwo" Fanchi, 5 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-05-episode-i-sealed-deck-tacticon-denverd2937/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Denver DPC]].

* '''Date:''' 1 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Tacticon, Denver, Colorado
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Fanchi]]
